item.blurb: Ampersand Raises $15M Series A. Ampersand raises $15M in Series A funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners to build integration infrastructure for enterprise AI agents.
Myca Raises $1.3M Pre-seed. Myca raises $1.3M pre-seed funding from Eximius Ventures, Indigram Labs Foundation, and Kriscore Capital to expand its AI platform for agribusiness.
Guardrail Technologies Raises $3M Seed. Guardrail Technologies raises $3M in seed funding led by Filter Fund Venture Capital to expand its AI security and control platform internationally.
Vocca raises $20M Series A led by Norrsken VC to answer medical practices’ phones with AI. Healthcare businesses in the US employ an estimated quarter of a million people to answer phone calls from…
Vitalize Raises $31M Series A. Vitalize raises $31M in a Series A funding round led by Oak HC/FT to scale its AI-powered hospital staffing and capacity management operating system.
